# LA Commute Analyzer

> A client-side web app that ranks 15 Los Angeles and Orange County neighborhoods by estimated drive time to a chosen workplace at a chosen hour, with gas cost, neighborhood ratings and a PDF export. Estimates are a heuristic (straight-line distance, distance-based speed, hourly traffic multiplier), not live traffic. No backend and no API keys.

## App

- [Live app](https://patrickking67.github.io/commute-analyzer/): pick a workplace or search an address, then compare neighborhoods

## Docs

## Code

- [Estimate math](https://github.com/patrickking67/commute-analyzer/blob/main/src/lib/commute.ts): traffic by hour, speed by distance, gas cost, ranking
- [Address search](https://github.com/patrickking67/commute-analyzer/blob/main/src/lib/geocode.ts): OpenStreetMap Nominatim client with validation
- [Neighborhood data](https://github.com/patrickking67/commute-analyzer/blob/main/src/data/neighborhoods.ts): coordinates and ratings
